question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Fanatic
solution:
The correct answer is "**Tolerant**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A **fanatic** means a **person whose enthusiasm for something is beyond normal.** 

 
 
• **Example:** *Joey was a **fanatic** when it was to food. *
 
 
 
• **Tolerant** means a person with a **lot of patience**.
 
 
• **Example: ***Nathan becomes **tolerant** when he is experimenting*. 
 
 
 
• Therefore, the antonym of "Fanatic" is "Tolerant".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Extremist** - the state of being extreme.

 
 
• **Example:** *Harry looks like an **extremist** because of his decision.*
 
 
 
• **Lunatic** - a person who has lost his mental stability.
 
 
• **Example:** *Losing his loved ones made Lee a **lunatic**.*
 
 
 
• **Fantastic **- Very good. 
 
 
• **Example:** *You will look **fantastic** in this attire. *
